facts.fact: 周一 Clara 下班路过 Target 买白色床品，想配 condo 的 Victorian chic 风格。
facts.anchor: On Monday afternoon I stop by Target on my way home from my part-time job at the library and choose some simple white sheets, a white down comforter, and a couple more pillows

facts.fact: 衣帽间那面精致镜子的镜框木工与 The Villa 大堂的一致，大堂多数由原主人所雕。
facts.anchor: The woodwork on the frame resembles the ones in the lobby of The Villa—most of them carved by the original owner.

facts.fact: Clara 猜镜子是 Ben Mitchell 家清空 condo 时落下的，打算打电话问管理处要不要还。
facts.anchor: I’ll have to call down to the office later and see if it’s Ben Mitchell’s and it accidentally got left behind when his family cleared out the condo.

facts.fact: 镜面灰尘上有一双掌心朝下按在正中的手印，位置怪异。
facts.anchor: Like someone put both hands, palm down, right in the middle of the mirror.

facts.fact: 手印比 Morgan 的手大得多——Clara 联想到门口那个神秘男人。
facts.anchor: The hands are also way too big to be Morgan’s.

facts.fact: Clara 的特质设定：每次靠近镜子都会积静电，平时靠不碰镜子躲开。
facts.anchor: Every time I’m close to mirrors, it’s like I gather extra static electricity.

facts.fact: 她模仿手印把手掌按上镜面，强电流比上次猛得多，顺着胳膊击上来。
facts.anchor: The same shock as before, but a lot stronger this time, shoots up my arm.

facts.fact: 章末：Clara 失衡前扑，直接穿镜而过——穿越发生。
facts.anchor: Then I tumble right through it.
